name: SBT
fix_description: In SBT_Price, do not use Smart_Bank_USDT_Balance() (likely balanceOf) to calculate token price as it can be manipulated via flash loan or donation. Use internal accounting of deposited amounts or a TWAP oracle instead.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short, single-transaction exploit with only a flash loan and a few direct protocol calls (_Start, Buy_SBT, Loan_Get), suggesting a straightforward business-logic flaw rather than a complex multi-contract attack chain. It requires limited protocol-specific understanding and the exploit path is obvious from the test, so an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
